title: Spel Semiconductor approves strategic tripartite MoU with Calsoft and Natronix-India
description: Spel Semiconductor Limited has formally approved a strategic tripartite Memorandum of Understanding with California Software Company Limited (Calsoft) and Natronix-India. The agreement, ratified on July 29, 2026, focuses on collaborative research, development, and intellectual property creation in semiconductor chips and artificial intelligence. Spel Semiconductor will manage assembly, test, mark, and package operations, while Natronix-India will handle semiconductor IC design and design IP. P. Balamurugan, Head Operations & Whole-Time Director, was authorized to execute the deal.
